info.name: Reports Insert Bank
info.description:
# Insert Bank from CASH IN BANK accounts

Destructive seed: truncates `bank` on master and all 5 clinic DBs if not empty, then inserts one row per bank brand mapped from master `account_type` leaves named `CASH IN BANK%`.

Example: `CASH IN BANK - BPI OPEX` → `bank.name = BPI`. Multiple accounts for the same brand are grouped; `account_type_ids` is a comma-separated list of leaf ids.

Does **not** truncate `bank_service_fee`. Existing fee `bank_id` values may become stale.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Body: `token`, `requester` (required)

request.description:
## POST `/reports/insert_bank`

Seeds `bank` on master, mobile, oakridge, mactan, consolacion, and mantlewood.

### Response
`truncated` counts per DB, `inserted` rows `{id, name, account_type_ids}`, optional `warnings`.
